sources.entry: Archimedes - Native macOS Markdown editor geared toward mathematical writing with inline LaTeX support.

summary.name: Archimedes
summary.one_liner: Archimedes is a native macOS Markdown and LaTeX editor designed to make mathematical writing easier, with a live typeset preview.
use_cases: writing mathematical documents on a Mac
writing Markdown notes with LaTeX equations
learning LaTeX without deep TeX knowledge
exporting typeset math as vector graphics
exporting documents to PDF or HTML
summary.what_it_does: Archimedes is a plain text and Markdown editor with syntax highlighting, keyboard shortcuts for common actions, and full Markdown support. Its Math Mode accepts a subset of LaTeX with over 700 commands, autocompletion, and automatic matching of braces and brackets. Users can draw symbols with a trackpad to get the corresponding LaTeX code, and a live preview renders the document as they type. The app also offers custom macros, a Navigator for table of contents, error checking, document statistics, and export to PDF, HTML, or vector graphics.
notable: Trackpad drawing recognizes symbols and inserts their LaTeX code
Live typeset preview with no compile button
Custom macros appear in autocompletion alongside built-in commands
Native macOS app built with Core Animation, PDFKit, Quick Look and WebKit
caveats: Pricing is not stated on the page (reviews mention a 'modest price' only)
Mac-only; the page points to a separate iPad version
Beta releases are offered via TestFlight for feedback on future versions
